places.name: Palamidi Fortress
places.ai_summary: A historic fortress perched on a hill, offering panoramic views of Nafplio and the Argolic Gulf.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the climb to the fortress.

attribution.title: Palamidi fortress (Nafplio, Greece)
attribution.author: The original uploader was Brastite at English Wikipedia.

places.name: Epidaurus Ancient Theater
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this ancient theater is renowned for its exceptional acoustics and well-preserved structure.

opening_hours.notes: Check for live performances during the summer.

places.place_tip: Test the acoustics by standing at the center of the stage.

places.name: Mycenae Archaeological Site
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, Mycenae is an ancient city known for its Lion Gate and royal tombs.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the royal tombs and the Lion Gate for a glimpse into ancient history.

attribution.title: Path upto the Lion Gate, Mycenae (28693130016)
attribution.author: Andy Hay from UK
attribution.description: Path up to the Lion Gate, Mycenae

places.name: Nafplio Old Town
places.ai_summary: The old town of Nafplio is a charming area with narrow streets, neoclassical buildings, and vibrant bougainvillea.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot. Guided tours available.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Syntagma Square and the Church of Agios Georgios.

attribution.title: Αρχαιολογικό Μουσείο Ναυπλίου 7711
attribution.author: C messier
attribution.description: The former arsenals of Nafplion, built in 1713, now housing the archaeological museum of Nafplio, as seen from Syntagma square.

places.name: Corinth Canal
places.ai_summary: An engineering marvel, the Corinth Canal connects the Aegean Sea with the Ionian Sea, cutting through the Isthmus of Corinth.

opening_hours.notes: Viewpoints available on both sides of the canal.

places.place_tip: Visit the canal bridge for a unique perspective.

places.name: Mystras Archaeological Site
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, Mystras is a well-preserved medieval town with stunning churches and palaces.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the Palace of the Despots and the Church of Agios Dimitrios.

attribution.title: Mystras palace
attribution.author: Aeleftherios
attribution.description: General view of the Palace of Mystras

places.name: Mani Peninsula Towers & Caves (Diros Caves)
places.ai_summary: The Diros Caves are a complex of impressive caves with stalactites, stalagmites, and an underground river.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours only. Book in advance.

places.place_tip: Wear a jacket, it can be cool inside the caves.

places.name: Monemvasia Castle Town
places.ai_summary: A medieval fortress town on a small island, connected to the mainland by a causeway. Known for its well-preserved Byzantine and medieval architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the narrow streets and visit the Church of Christ in Chains.

places.name: Kalamata
places.ai_summary: A vibrant city known for its olives, Kalamata also offers a beautiful waterfront, archaeological museum, and nearby ancient sites.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the Kalamata Castle and the Archaeological Museum.

places.place_tip: Try the local olives and olive oil.

attribution.title: Kalamata, Peloponnese, Greece
attribution.author: Pfloros at English Wikipedia

places.name: Ancient Corinth
places.ai_summary: The ruins of Ancient Corinth include the Temple of Apollo, the Agora, and the Acrocorinth fortress.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the Acrocorinth for a panoramic view of the area.

places.name: Temple of Apollo Epicurius at Bassae (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: An ancient Greek temple dedicated to Apollo Epicurius, known for its unique architecture and beautiful mountain setting.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Admire the unique architectural features, including the temple's frieze.
places.address: Temple of Apollo Epicurius, Bassae, Greece

places.name: Pylos & Nestor's Palace
places.ai_summary: The archaeological site of Pylos includes the ruins of Nestor's Palace, an important Mycenaean site.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Look for the well-preserved frescoes and the throne room.

attribution.title: Pylos-sfaktiria
attribution.author: Flyax
attribution.description: View of Pylos from the East; inner port, bay of Navarino and Sfaktiria

places.name: Voidokilia Beach
places.ai_summary: A stunning beach with a unique curved shape, fine sand, and crystal-clear waters, located near Pylos.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Swim and relax in the clear waters, and explore the nearby caves.

places.name: Kardamyli
places.ai_summary: A picturesque village with stone houses, narrow streets, and a beautiful beach, located in the Mani Peninsula.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the village and enjoy the local cuisine.

places.place_tip: Visit the old olive oil mill and the beach.

attribution.title: Kadamyli from Proastio
attribution.author: Tgvtornado
attribution.description: View of Kardamyli, Greece from Proastio on a cliff to the south

places.name: Vouraikos Gorge & Odontotos Rack Railway
places.ai_summary: A scenic gorge with a narrow gauge railway, offering stunning views of the cliffs, river, and lush vegetation.

opening_hours.notes: Check the train schedule in advance.

places.place_tip: Take the train ride for a unique perspective of the gorge.

places.place_tip: Wear a jacket, it can be cool inside the caves.

places.name: Nemea Archaeological Site
places.ai_summary: The ancient site of Nemea is famous for the Temple of Zeus and the Nemean Games.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the site of the ancient stadium and the Temple of Zeus.

attribution.title: Archaeological Museum of Nemea, Building, 201796

places.name: Taygetus Mountain
places.ai_summary: The Taygetus Mountain range offers stunning natural beauty, hiking trails, and the chance to see the rare Taygetus fir tree.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the spring or fall.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, and wear sturdy shoes.

attribution.title: Taygetos Ilias 1
attribution.author: Herbert Ortner, Vienna, Austria
attribution.description: Profitis Ilias in the Taygetos mountains, with 2.407 meters it is the highest mountain on the Peloponnese peninsula. The peak is on the left side. Pinus nigra forest in foreground.

places.name: Porto Heli
places.ai_summary: A picturesque town known for its beautiful harbor, beaches, and as a gateway to the island of Spetses.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the town and enjoy the local seafood.

places.place_tip: Take a boat trip to the island of Spetses.

places.name: Karytaina Castle
places.ai_summary: A medieval castle offering panoramic views of the surrounding area, located in the village of Karytaina.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the village of Karytaina for a glimpse of traditional Greek architecture.
